title: AAT Accounts Assistant
description:
AAT Accounts Assistant

Robert Half are delighted to be partnering with an innovative and growing technology business based in Cardiff to recruit an AAT Accounts Assistant.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious finance professional looking to join a forward-thinking organisation that can offer genuine career progression, exposure to a broad range of finance responsibilities, and ongoing AAT study support. The successful candidate will become a key member of the finance team and play an important role in supporting the day-to-day accounting function while developing their career within the business.

Key Responsibilities
- Supporting the production of monthly management accounts.
- Managing accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.
- Performing bank, supplier, and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Assisting with month-end and year-end close activities.
- Processing journals, accruals, and prepayments.
- Monitoring cash flow and supporting cash management activities.
- Investigating and resolving financial queries.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring data integrity.
- Assisting with financial reporting and analysis.
- Supporting process improvements and finance transformation initiatives.

About the Candidate

The ideal candidate will have:
- AAT qualification or be actively studying towards completion.
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant, Assistant Accountant, or similar finance role.
- Strong understanding of core accounting principles.
- Good Excel skills and confidence working with financial systems.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- A proactive approach with a willingness to learn and develop.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across the business.

What's on Offer?
- AAT study support and ongoing professional development.
- Clear progression opportunities within a growing finance team.
- Exposure to a broad range of accounting responsibilities.
- Opportunity to work for an innovative technology company.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Modern Cardiff office location with excellent transport links.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

This role would suit an ambitious finance professional who is looking to build on their existing experience while continuing their studies and progressing towards a more senior accounting position in the future.

title: Accounts Payable/Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Role Purpose

To deliver a professional, efficient and accurate purchase ledger service, ensuring all supplier invoices are processed, approved and paid on time in line with company deadlines and agreed payment terms, while maintaining strong relationships with suppliers and effective day-to-day communication with internal departments.

Main Responsibilities

Invoice Processing
- Process all supplier invoices in a timely manner to ensure monthly deadlines are met (generally 2 days after month's end).
- Perform 3-way matching of delivery notes, invoices and purchase orders.
- Post invoices that have been "released" in the approval flow.
- Follow the authorisation process where invoices do not have a purchase order.
- Identify missing invoices and delivery notes and request them in a timely manner.
- Review supplier portals and download invoices.

Supplier Payments & Banking
- Prepare and complete the supplier payment run twice monthly, in line with the Company's agreed payment dates.
- Upload bank payments as required and reconcile the payment run with bank accounts.
- Complete the department cashflow statement with payment run figures and send remittances twice monthly.
- Reconcile supplier accounts to ensure payments, credits and invoices are correctly allocated.

Reconciliations & Month End
- Complete month-end reconciliations.
- Check and reconcile all supplier statements monthly, querying any discrepancies.
- Document and resolve queries arising on the purchase ledger accounts.

Supplier Management
- Enter new suppliers into Business Central and maintain and update supplier information to ensure the data on the Company's financial systems is accurate and compliant.
- Liaise with internal departments and suppliers regarding queries and ensure timely resolution.
- Complete credit account application forms as and when required.
- Be the first point of contact for telephone AP enquiries.

Qualifications & Skills
- Finance experience preferred.
- Experienced in using Excel, Word and Microsoft Office.
- Good analytical, problem-solving and numerical skills.
- Ability to work in a team and independently.
- Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets and finance systems (Business Central experience advantageous).

Personal Attributes
- Enthusiastic and self-motivated individual with the ability to work on own initiative.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload and meet deadlines.
- Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to work independently.
- Logical and methodical approach, with the ability and willingness to actively get involved in other areas of the department as required.
- Flexible and adaptable.

Excellent overall package in a fantastic culture.
